notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: נפש i makim laif/spirit/breth — Tok Pisin 'bel' i holim tingting na laik, i no savel bilong bodi tasol

notes.subject: ותקצר נפשו
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'bel bilong em i sot' — em i pasin bilong no inap talim beten; Tok Pisin i tanim long 'no inap holim gut moa'

notes.subject: bel bilong em
notes.rationale: Sapos 'bel bilong em' em i bel bilong Yisrael (Am Israel) o bel bilong Yahwe — planti tanima i no wanbel

translation: Na ol i rausim ⟨את⟩ ol god bilong ol man bilong narapela hap i stap long namel bilong ol, na ol i wok long ⟨את⟩ Yahwe; na bel bilong em i no inap holim gut moa long hevi bilong Yisrael.
